conventions.evidence: every deadline, amount and issuer requires a verbatim snippet in 'evidence' under its field path, and the snippet has to contain the value it is offered for. An asserted value with no snippet, a blank one, or one that quotes text saying something else is nulled and the claim is flagged REQUIRES_HUMAN_CONFIRMATION
conventions.verbatim: verbatim cannot be verified here. There is no document text to diff a snippet against, only an image the model already looked at, so this checks that the extracted value appears in the text quoted for it. That catches a number quoted against text saying a different number. It does not catch a snippet invented whole, and no check available here would
conventions.decision: insurer_decision is read off the document as one of paid, partially_paid, rejected, pending, not_stated; this tool never assesses coverage itself
conventions.outstanding: outstanding = billed - insurer_paid - household_paid, floored at zero; any excess is reported as refund_due instead of a negative outstanding
